subject: Cardinal Labs — Sales to CS handoff: kickoff + SOW
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.m@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.m@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.z@cardinallabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Cardinal Labs — Sales to CS handoff: kickoff + SOW

Team — attaching the signed SOW and the top-line notes from the sales phase so we can kick the implementation off. TL;DR: Cardinal Labs is live with our Hosted API for inference (text-generation + embeddings). They committed to a 12-month contract (see deal id CRD-2027-0421) with a targeted pilot go-live in mid-June and production traffic ramp in July.

Key context / asks for CS & Implementation:
- Primary objective: integrate Redwood API to replace existing on-prem model routing for their extraction pipeline; expected peak concurrent QPS ~450 after ramp.
- Must support strict PHI handling and audit logs; customer requires SOC2 artifacts and per-route audit retention for 13 months (they are requesting confirmation of retention windows).
- Timeline: pilot kickoff week of 6/7, 2-week pilot, production target 7/12. We agreed on a single canary model variant for pilot and will enable caching and prefix-KV optimizations.
- Blockers flagged in sales: procurement has a PO (attached), security requested our completed questionnaire (attached), and they want an on-call contact during pilot windows (we should define).

Owner recommendations (sales-side):
- Implementation lead: Karthik (will handle runtime config, staging, validations)
- PM / schedule owner: Tessa (kickoff scheduling, tasking, stakeholder sync)
- Customer success: Monica (adoption, success metrics, escalation)

Attachments: Cardinal_SOW_v1.pdf (signed), Cardinal_Security_QA.pdf (customer questions), Cardinal_PO_20270528.pdf (procurement).

Action items: please confirm owners, validate timeline, and call out any immediate risks or missing items. Emily — thanks again for signing; if I've missed anything critical, flag it here and we'll incorporate into the kickoff agenda.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.m@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.m@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.z@cardinallabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cardinal Labs — Sales to CS handoff: kickoff + SOW

Thanks Rafael — I can take Implementation lead. A few clarifying notes / risks I want on the table before we lock the pilot window: 

1) Data residency & PHI: the customer called out PHI handling — we need to confirm whether Cardinal will push masked payloads to the Hosted API or if they require a private deployment. From the sales convo it sounded like they prefer hosted but will send limited PHI. Monica, can you confirm the compliance posture they expect from success?

2) QPS / scaling: peak concurrent QPS ~450 is notable. For pilot we should define an insertion rate (tokens/s) and set a throttling plan. We should also decide whether to start pilot on a lower throughput baseline to validate correctness. Rafael — do we have historical estimates from their telemetry?

3) Acceptance tests: I propose a short set of observability checks we run during the 2-week pilot: 
  - End-to-end latency 95th < 400ms for generation requests under pilot load
  - KV cache hit rate > 30% for certain prefixes (we'll need sample prompt shapes)
  - No regressions in hallucination tests on our evaluation prompts (I'll prepare these)

4) Security artifacts: I'll review the Cardinal_Security_QA and follow up to the security team if anything requires redline.

Owners confirmed: Implementation = Karthik; PM = Tessa; CS Lead = Monica. I'll draft the pilot validation checklist and share a first pass by EOD Monday.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Implementation | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.m@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.m@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.z@cardinallabs.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cardinal Labs — Sales to CS handoff: kickoff + SOW

Thanks all — setting up kickoff logistics. Proposed schedule options (30–45 minute sync):
- Option A: Wed 9 Jun, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Thu 10 Jun, 14:00–14:45 PT

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Pilot objectives & success criteria (10m)
3) Timeline & milestones (10m)
4) Technical pre-reqs & access (10m)
5) Next steps / owners (5m)

Pre-kickoff asks from our side:
- Emily: sample prompt templates and a sanitized sample payload (to validate schema and KV prefix patterns).
- Emily: confirm whether Cardinal will supply a staging API key or prefer to use tokenized test creds.
- Emily / procurement: confirm PO billing contact and if any invoicing notes required.

I've created a shared kickoff doc (Drive link in metadata). I'll send a calendar invite once Emily confirms preferred slot. Rafael — noted that on-call contact needs to be assigned during pilot; I'd like to propose a rotating on-call roster: Karthik (weekdays) and Monica (escalations).

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Technical Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@cardinallabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.m@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.m@redwood.com>, procurement@cardinallabs.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cardinal Labs — Sales to CS handoff: kickoff + SOW

Hi Tessa / team — thanks for the clear plan and sorry for the slight delay. Option A (Wed 9 Jun, 10:00 PT) works for us — please send calendar invite.

Attached: Cardinal_Security_QA.pdf (we completed the security questionnaire on our end and included required clarifications), Cardinal_PO_20270528.pdf (PO for invoicing). Procurement contact is Monica Lee <monica.lee@cardinallabs.com> — please include her on any billing threads.

Pre-kickoff deliverables from our side:
- Sanitized sample payload + prompt templates (s3 link included in the Drive folder).
- Staging API key: we will provision a scoped test key for the pilot (expires 7/15).
- List of peak windows: we expect steady traffic 09:00–17:00 ET, with potential spike windows around 11:30–12:30 ET.

On PHI: Cardinal confirms data will be pseudo-anonymized for the pilot, but production may include PHI flows. We need to discuss data residency and whether further controls (private deployment) are required before production.

See you on 6/9.

—Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Integrations | Cardinal Labs
